implemented_behavior: XDP_COUNTERS Array -> PerCpuArray: per-CPU slots eliminate multi-core RMW count loss
New counters: tx (XDP_TX terminal actions), acl_blocked (ACL-rule terminal drops)
count_action now records XDP_TX into tx instead of dropping it on the floor
block_action counts ACL-originated drops distinctly from other drop sources
userspace sum_percpu_counters aggregates all CPU slots with saturating_add
zero_counters resets all per-CPU slots via PerCpuValues
compatibility_and_migrations: XDP_ABI_VERSION 1->2. Old Array-typed XDP_COUNTERS pin is rejected by the spec check and explicitly unlinked+recreated on attach; old counter values are not migrated (telemetry only). No connection map is cleared or touched. New userspace rejects old-ABI maps via PerCpuArray::try_from failure — no silent fallback.
resource_bounds_and_full_behavior: PerCpuArray value 144B x nr_cpus; userspace aggregation iterates nr_cpus slots per status refresh (10s interval).
failure_and_rollback_behavior: Stale/incompatible counter pin: explicit unlink + recreate at attach (observable via load logs). Missing map: explicit error. No silent degrade path added.
tests_covered: cloud-node-xdp-common suite (7 pass, incl. 144B layout assert + ABI v2)
real eBPF attach + live traffic on veth/netns: dump-maps counters exact-match sent packets (7 pkts = 6 redirect + 1 pass)
